_comment: Values of maxspeed:type / source:maxspeed that the builder turns into an implied limit
(flags src = 2; the reader gives it confidence 0.5). Only zones whose value is fixed by law
everywhere the tag is used belong here. Road-class defaults ('residential = 25 mph',
'US:urban', 'US:rural', ...) are intentionally NOT applied: they vary by state and city, and a
wrong implied limit roasts a driver for nothing. US-DC:urban is the District's statutory
default of 20 mph where no limit is posted (18 DCMR 2200.6, in force since June 2020).
